extraFacts.fact: A JIC 37° flare end (SAE J514, ISO 8434-2) seals metal-to-metal on a 74° included cone and is not interchangeable with a 45° SAE flare.
DIN 2353 (ISO 8434-1) is the 24° cone bite-type tube fitting standard; the light (L) and heavy (S) series differ in tube outside diameter and thread.
A crimp fitting is rated only on the hose series it is designed for; the fitting, ferrule and crimp specification are checked against the hose before supply.
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics Aeroquip/Dixon crimp fitting listings (Hose and fitting match note)
